name: mirage
text: Checked each upgrade from the research. Novig's higher watched-market and order limits: already adopted, with no change needed, because the app reads the cap from /v3/limits every time it connects, so the bigger numbers apply by themselves. Novig's originalQty field: not worth changing, since fills are already recorded from Novig's fill records, which are the accurate source. PropLine's team key: Novig has no matching key, so I'd still have to match by name and the key would add nothing. SharpAPI's $149 websocket add-on: that costs money, so it's your call. Nothing from the docs is both safe and useful to ship right now. I'm moving on to the player and prop matching audit.
